packageRules.description: The UI stack moves as a unit. walkers pins an exact egui minor, and egui-wgpu pins a wgpu major, so a PR that carries only one of these five is a PR that cannot be correct. Keep this list in step with the '-- UI stack (bump as a unit) --' block in the workspace Cargo.toml.

Hard ceiling on wgpu, because grouping alone does not stop this: when only wgpu has a new major, the group PR still bumps wgpu alone. egui-wgpu 0.35 requires wgpu ^29, so a lone wgpu 30 does not upgrade anything -- cargo resolves a SECOND wgpu beside egui-wgpu's, nothing in the workspace references it (every wgpu path goes through egui_wgpu::wgpu), native stays green, and on wasm32 both copies compile their vendored WebGPU bindings until wasm-bindgen aborts with 'duplicate string enums: GpuFilterMode'. That is exactly what 031bb4b did and CI did not catch it. Raise this ceiling only when egui-wgpu itself accepts the newer wgpu, and raise it in the same PR as the egui group.
